Name: PFM Upgraded Jars
Author: Thefox536
Description:
[b]The Main File (Use this if you use the mod Quality Products)[/b]
These Jars also keep the quality of whatever was put into them.
[b]The Optional File [b](Use this if you don't use the mod Quality Products)[/b][/b]
These Jars also follow the default jars function, the quality of whatever was put into them is ignored.

[b]1.0.3[/b]
﻿BugFix: Fixes missing Chinese Translations.
[b]1.0.2[/b]
BugFix: ﻿Fixes Buying from Clint to allow the Recipes to be bought properly.
﻿Feature: Allows for Buying the Machine from Clint as well, for 40% of the cost of the Recipe.
[b]1.0.1[/b]
﻿Adds Chinese Translations thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/76474198]asqwedcxz741[/url]
﻿Adds buying the recipe from Clint, instead of just getting the recipe by default.


[b]Install Instructions[/b]
﻿Extract the folder into the main Mods Folder

[b]Update Instructions[/b]
Remove the following from the Mods Folder
﻿ ﻿﻿"[JA] Upgraded Jars"
﻿﻿"[PFM] Upgraded Jars"


I've never uploaded anything here before, and I just made these today, so let me know if anything doesn't work right.
